'''Kema''' is a [[Kin]]swoman.

== Appearance ==
She is dark-skinned and has black hair tied in three braids.

== Activities ==
Like all the Kinswomen in the [[farm]], she travelled to [[Andor]] with [[Elayne]]. 

Kema, with the assistance of three other Kinswomen, creates a [[gateway]] into [[Cairhien]] for [[Elayne Trakand]].
